name: agent-charter
description: Build from the spec. Check against the source. Plugins that keep AI agents tied to their governing sources: independent review, decision support, and Figma-to-frontend governance.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Independent review of finished work. fresh-eyes: get an independent check that finished work is correct (code against its spec, a plan, a decision, a document or filing), judged from its governing sources, with findings fixed or reported.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Think it through before you act. decision-council: stress-test a costly decision before you commit. best-of-n: compare n approaches to a problem, then build the best. risk-evaluation: see what could go wrong with one plan, how likely, how bad. ask-specialist: get an independent, deep answer to one hard question.

plugins.name: figma-workflow
plugins.description: Governance for Figma to frontend, on top of Figma's MCP server and Code Connect: plan a screen from its Figma frame (new or changed) with a mapping table and one approval, build it as a clickable no-backend prototype, keep it in sync as the design changes, and audit it independently. Stack adapters for server-rendered and component stacks.
